method: Independent exhaustive earliest-service sequence search with homogeneous-resource symmetry and componentwise dominance; no production validator or MILP builder is reused
proof: Original joint dwell can contract to a common T0 interval without increasing Cmax. For any fixed three resource orders, earliest difference-constraint times are integral when T0–T4 are integer. Enumerating all admissible service orders at H-1 proves the integer optimum lower bound. Capacity pruning uses only remaining SMV alternating pairs; unused vehicles/lanes are enforced.
